messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: EmberBank (enterprise-vpc) — Missing traces for tenant emberbank, elevated user reports for p95 latency debugging. Auto-page to #incidents and current on-call.

marta_sre: saw the alert. metrics + logs look normal for emberbank but spans absent from our trace index starting ~2167848800. paging SRE now.

sam_oncall: I'm on it. reading the incident summary: 'trace-forwarder' in emberbank VPC shows repeated 403s to trace-indexer last 22m. Can someone from runtime confirm forwarder auth?

jess_eng_runtime: jumping in — we onboarded emberbank's forwarder into a tenant-scoped role. Quick check: running existing health endpoint on the forwarder.

arjun_obs: FYI traces and logs diverge: logs show events, but span_id -> trace_id mapping missing in collector. This looks like indexing write failures, not sampling.

lina_support: I just spoke to Kevin (EmberBank SE) — customer is actively debugging a user-facing flakiness for a payments flow. They want ETA on a fix.

kevin_se_emberbank: Confirmed. We can repro missing spans across multiple requests. We need temporary read access to traces while they triage. Also they asked for a short-lived workaround so their debugging tools can see spans.

marta_sre: ok plan: 1) triage root cause (auth vs index partition), 2) if auth, create ephemeral role for emberbank forwarder and rotate token, 3) if index partition, mirror to fallback index and replay. We'll try auth first.

jess_eng_runtime: checking trace-forwarder logs from the forwarder agent in VPC. grab logs:

```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z TRACE-FWD ERROR write indexer: HTTP 403 Forbidden - AccessDenied
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z TRACE-FWD INFO retrying token refresh
2026-03-15T09:12:10Z TRACE-FWD ERROR write indexer: HTTP 403 Forbidden - AccessDenied
2026-03-15T09:13:42Z TRACE-FWD INFO dropped 128 spans due to consecutive 403s
```

jess_eng_runtime: 403s to trace-indexer. suspect role binding drift after a recent IAM policy push.

arjun_obs: I can query our control plane audit logs for role changes. Pulling 'policy:tenant-forwarder-writes' events.

arjun_obs: found an automated policy rollout at 2167848300 that removed a granular allow for emberbank-tenant. Looks like a wildcard policy accidentally over-removed tenant-scoped write.

marta_sre: confirmed. root cause = policy rollout removed emberbank's write permission to trace-indexer. Two mitigation options: revert rollout (broad fix) or create an emergency tenant-scoped role override for emberbank (fast, less blast radius). Revert will take ~20-30m with approvals.

sam_oncall: we should do the override now to restore customer access ASAP and then revert the rollout as follow-up. Who can create the override?

jess_eng_runtime: I can create a temporary role 'emberbank-trace-write-ephemeral' and attach it to the forwarder service account via the control plane. Command below (will require approval token):

```
# create ephemeral role (control-plane CLI)
redwoodctl iam roles create --name emberbank-trace-write-ephemeral --permissions trace:index:write --ttl 3600 --scopes tenant:emberbank
# bind to forwarder SA
redwoodctl iam roles bind --role emberbank-trace-write-ephemeral --service-account forwarder-emberbank-sa
```

lina_support: I'm authorizing this — creating an incident exception now (reason: customer-impacting missing traces). Approving ephemeral role creation.

marta_sre: @jess_eng_runtime proceed with role creation. After role is bound, we should force forwarder token rotation and tail logs to confirm 200s.

jess_eng_runtime: role created and bound. firing token rotation job against forwarder:

```
redwoodctl agents trigger-rotate --agent forwarder-emberbank --reason "ephemeral role bind"
```

jess_eng_runtime: logs show immediate improvement:

```
2026-03-15T09:27:15Z TRACE-FWD INFO token refresh ok
2026-03-15T09:27:16Z TRACE-FWD INFO write indexer: HTTP 200 OK - shards ack
2026-03-15T09:27:16Z TRACE-FWD INFO replayed 128 buffered spans
```

kevin_se_emberbank: we're starting to see spans appear in EmberBank's observability console. Confirming with their devs — spans visible for repro case. They can continue triage. Huge thanks.

marta_sre: Great. Next steps: 1) keep ephemeral role for 1 hour (ttl=3600) while we revert the erroneous policy rollout, 2) revert rollout and run a controlled policy re-deploy with tenant-allow unit tests, 3) post-incident RCA.

sam_oncall: assigning follow-up to jess_eng_runtime and arjun_obs for revert + tests. I'll record the incident in PagerDuty and create a postmortem draft.

lina_support: told EmberBank SE the temporary fix is in place and we've scheduled a full revert. They requested a short postmortem and copies of audit events — I'll bundle those once RCA is ready.

jess_eng_runtime: kicked off the revert PR with a focused diff and added an explicit tenant binding test. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/policy/revert/12345 — requesting expedited review.

arjun_obs: saved audit snapshot and exported the offending policy change events to the incident channel. Also scheduled a replay of the buffered spans into the primary index after the revert to ensure no data loss.

marta_sre: placing the thread into 'mitigated' state. If anyone sees regression, re-open. Postmortem owner: sam_oncall. RCA owner: arjun_obs.

kevin_se_emberbank: thanks all. I'll follow up with the customer and collect their notes for the PM.

marta_sre: final notes for the postmortem: cause = automated policy rollout removed tenant-scoped write. Impact = EmberBank experienced missing traces for ~35m during peak debugging window; metrics/logs unaffected; mitigation = ephemeral role bind + token rotation; follow-up = revert rollout + add tenant-rules test.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated — EmberBank trace visibility restored. Incident severity: Sev2 -> downgraded to Sev3 post-mitigation. Total time to mitigation: ~15m from initial page.
